blocks.html: If a commercial development is constructed on a vacant Commercial Infill Site previously occupied by a commercial building on or before July 1, 1981, or an existing commercial building located on a Commercial Infill Site is replaced by a commercial development, the number of accessory off-street parking spaces provided by the commercial development shall be equal to or greater than the number of accessory off-street parking spaces provided by the building it replaced.
